description: Decide whether a failed HTTP call may be retried, must be reconciled, or must not be repeated — Given a request's method, how it ended (response status, timeout, reset, refused), idempotency-key evidence and optional caller policy, returns retry / do-not-retry / reconcile / unknown for an agent deciding what to do after a failed tool or API call. Encodes RFC 9110 method idempotency, the proxy and retry-of-a-retry rules and Retry-After parsing; a timeout or reset is never read as success or a

asOf.description: RFC 3339 instant; needed only to turn a Retry-After HTTP-date into seconds.

attempt.description: 1-based number of the attempt that just ended. Default 1.

automatic.description: True when the retry would be issued automatically (library or proxy) rather than by a deliberate decision.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-asserted evidence: the engine knows no vendor's key semantics.

serverHonors.description: Whether the provider documents that it deduplicates on this key for this operation.

notProcessedStatuses.description: Statuses the vendor documents as 'rejected before processing'.

retryStatuses.description: If given, only these statuses may be retried.

requestSent.description: Whether request bytes reached the network. connection-refused and dns-failure imply not-sent.

name: retry-admissibility
